title: workflow/1.0/problem-report
description: Reports a failure on the thread of the message that caused it. Codes in the definition: template_not_found, template_invalid, instance_not_found, guard_failed, action_failed, discovery_failed, not_authorized, not_found_remote_template, multiplicity_violation, vault_unavailable, vault_ref_invalid, sensitivity_violation. @ajna-inc/workflow also sends invalid_template, invalid_event (including an unknown instance), forbidden (connection mismatch, paused or canceled instance), already_exists (singleton policy), idempotency_conflict, state_conflict, action_error, missing_attributes and temporary_unavailable. (didcomm.org workflow/1.0)

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. REQUIRED when the message is authcrypted.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.
